title: Chicken Noodle Soup Shortcut
description: Fast homestyle soup using cooked chicken and egg noodles.

steps.text: Bring 8 cups chicken broth, 2 sliced carrots, 2 sliced celery stalks, and 1/2 teaspoon thyme to a simmer.
Add 3 cups egg noodles and cook according to package directions, usually 6–8 minutes.
Stir in 2 cups cooked shredded chicken and heat 2 minutes.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days; noodles soften as they sit.

title: Slow Cooker Potato Soup
description: Creamy comforting potato soup with very little hands-on work.

steps.text: Put 2 pounds diced potatoes, 1 diced onion, 4 cups broth, and 1 teaspoon salt in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7 hours, until potatoes are very soft.
Mash some of the potatoes in the cooker, leaving some chunks.
Stir in 1 cup milk and 4 ounces cream cheese until smooth and hot.

title: Baked Ziti with Spinach
description: Cheesy baked pasta with marinara and spinach.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Cook 12 ounces ziti 2 minutes less than package directions; drain.
Mix pasta with 24 ounces marinara, 2 cups spinach, and 1 cup ricotta or cottage cheese.
Spread in a 9x13-inch dish and top with 2 cups mozzarella.
Bake 25–30 minutes until bubbling and browned in spots.

title: Turkey Meatball Marinara Subs
description: Warm turkey meatballs, marinara, and cheese tucked into toasted rolls.

steps.text: Heat oven to 400°F. Warm 16 turkey meatballs in 2 cups marinara in a saucepan for about 10 minutes.
Split 4 sub rolls and place them on a baking sheet.
Fill rolls with meatballs and sauce, then top with 1 cup mozzarella.
Bake 5–7 minutes until rolls are warm and cheese is melted.
